text:
Springowl Associates Increases Position in Oclaro (OCLR); Davidson Investment Advisors Has Cut Its Position in Morgan Stanley (MS) by $4.33 Million 
January 9, 2018 - By Nellie Frank 
Davidson Investment Advisors decreased its stake in Morgan Stanley (MS) by 33.76% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Davidson Investment Advisors sold 90,163 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.43% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 176,934 shares of the investment bankers and brokers and service company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $8.52 million, down from 267,097 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Davidson Investment Advisors who had been investing in Morgan Stanley for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $96.53B market cap company. The stock increased 0.95% or $0.503 during the last trading session, reaching $53.393. About 4.58 million shares traded. Morgan Stanley (NYSE:MS) has risen 57.08% since January 9, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 40.38% the S&P500. 
Andrew Wallach increased its stake in Oclaro Inc (OCLR) by 50% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Springowl Associates Llc bought 50,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 22.87% while stock markets rallied. The hedge fund run by Andrew Wallach held 150,000 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $1.30 million, up from 100,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Springowl Associates Llc who had been investing in Oclaro Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.19 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 2.49% or $0.1799 during the last trading session, reaching $7.0501. About 2.97M shares traded. Oclaro, Inc. (NASDAQ:OCLR) has risen 92.74% since January 9, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 76.04% the S&P500. 
Among 29 analysts covering Morgan Stanley ( NYSE:MS ), 19 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 10 Hold. Therefore 66% are positive. Morgan Stanley had 89 analyst reports since July 21, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The stock has “Market Perform” rating by Wood on Tuesday, April 19. The firm has “Equalweight” rating given on Wednesday, April 6 by Barclays Capital. Oppenheimer maintained the stock with “Hold” rating in Wednesday, July 19 report. The stock has “Overweight” rating by JP Morgan on Tuesday, February 16. RBC Capital Markets maintained it with “Outperform” rating and $38.0 target in Tuesday, October 20 report. Buckingham Research upgraded the stock to “Buy” rating in Tuesday, August 25 report. On Friday, April 21 the stock rating was maintained by Vining Sparks with “Strong-Buy”. On Wednesday, August 23 the stock rating was maintained by BMO Capital Markets with “Buy”. On Monday, October 9 the stock rating was maintained by Citigroup with “Neutral”. The stock has “Outperform” rating by RBC Capital Markets on Wednesday, October 7.
